meta.scope: Suriname batch 1 — Phase 0+1. Core statistical system (ABS), central bank, mining/oil structure, upcoming offshore oil (Block 58 / GranMorgu), poverty and macro context. Final South America country under the catch-up.
meta.strategy_note: Follows NEXT-COUNTRY-STRATEGY.md after Guyana checkpoint. Small population (~0.6–0.7 m), gold + onshore oil as current backbone, major offshore oil development (TotalEnergies/APA) targeting first oil ~2028.

candidates.title: Algemeen Bureau voor de Statistiek (ABS) — General Bureau of Statistics
candidates.description: National statistical office. Produces census, national accounts, prices, trade, labour and social statistics. Semi-autonomous foundation under the Ministry of Finance.
referenced_by: Central Bank and planning documents that cite ABS series
candidates.notes: Institutional parent node for Surinamese official statistics.

candidates.title: Centrale Bank van Suriname (CBvS)
candidates.description: Central bank. Produces monetary, external-sector, inflation and related macroeconomic statistics; conducts monetary and exchange-rate policy.
candidates.notes: Monetary and external statistical authority. Complements ABS on prices, balance of payments and financial indicators. Recent years have been marked by high inflation and stabilisation efforts.

candidates.title: National Accounts / GDP
candidates.description: System of national accounts. Mining (gold) and oil dominate value-added and exports; economy experienced a deep crisis in the early 2020s with large real per-capita GDP decline.
candidates.notes: Core macroeconomic product. Mining and oil account for a large share of GDP and ~90% of exports. Per-capita GDP fell sharply from the mid-2010s peak; offshore oil is expected to produce a step-change from ~2028.

candidates.title: Staatsolie — national oil company
candidates.description: State oil company. Operates onshore production and holds participating interests in offshore developments (including Block 58 / GranMorgu).
candidates.notes: Institutional parent of the hydrocarbon sector. Continuously cited in production, fiscal and investment analysis; has exercised option to take equity in the major offshore project.

candidates.title: Block 58 / GranMorgu offshore oil development
candidates.description: Major offshore oil development in the Suriname-Guyana basin. Final investment decision taken; targeting ~220,000 b/d from ~2028 with multi-billion USD investment.
candidates.notes: Transformative future production node. Analogous to Guyana’s Stabroek in potential impact; first oil expected later in the decade. Continuously cited as the central medium-term growth and fiscal prospect.

candidates.title: Gold production and exports
candidates.description: Gold mining and export statistics. Current backbone of the extractive economy alongside onshore oil.
candidates.notes: Primary current extractive earner. Together with oil, accounts for the large majority of merchandise exports and a major share of GDP.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index / Inflation
candidates.description: Consumer price index and inflation measures. High and persistent inflation has been a defining feature of the early-2020s crisis period.
candidates.notes: Flagship price statistic under stress. Annual inflation ran above 50% for an extended period; stabilisation remains a central policy objective.

candidates.title: Poverty measurement
candidates.description: Poverty headcount and related indicators. Crisis-period deterioration was more severe for less-educated and interior households; recent estimates place poverty in the mid-teens to higher range depending on the line used.
candidates.notes: Social-outcome node. Interior (hinterland) and less-educated households were hit hardest in the crisis; ABS participates in methodological work on multidimensional poverty.

candidates.title: Paramaribo — capital metropolitan core
candidates.description: Capital city and primary urban, commercial and administrative centre. Dominant demographic and economic concentration.
candidates.notes: Lived urban core. Continuously appears as the main geographic domain in household and labour statistics.

candidates.title: Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys.
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic product. Population on the order of 0.6–0.7 million; supports national accounts rebasing and SDG indicator updates.

proposed_edges.basis: Staatsolie holds a participating interest in the Block 58 / GranMorgu development.
Gold is a major component of GDP and exports.
Oil production and refining contribute materially to value-added and exports.
Price statistics are produced in the ABS/CBvS statistical system.
National accounts are compiled under the ABS framework.
Paramaribo is the primary urban domain of the census.
